entries.speaker: Challenge Battle Screen
entries.en: During a Challenge Battle, you can view your[n]current score, the score needed to obtain a[n]reward, and the score bonus requirements.

entries.speaker: Challenge Battle Screen
entries.en: Even if you lose a Challenge Battle, the game[n]won't end. If you feel that you can't win, press[n][f 1 10 50] and select [clr 2]Escape[clr 27] in the [clr 2]Order[clr 27] menu.

entries.speaker: Challenge Battle Screen
entries.en: Challenge Battle scores are based on damage dealt.[n]Aim for a high score by dealing massive damage.
